items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: During that period Lester Young, Herschel Evans, and Count Basie and all the musicians used to go down to the Subway to hear Monk play.

ctx.x: When did you first meet Thelonious Monk?

I think it was the year of 1930 in Kansas City. He was traveling with a show somewhat like a medicine show. The music was so great in Kansas City so he stopped off there. They had opened up a new night club called the Subway or something like that in Kansas City and I met Monk there and he was playing the same way he plays now. No one understood it. I used to hang out with him and we became great friends then. During that period Lester Young, Herschel Evans, and Count Basie and all the musicians used to go down…
What happened to music in Kansas City because of Monk?
